name: projectsummer
description: Query, analyse and explore your own Letterboxd library.
long_description: Serves the Letterboxd library you built with the `summer` CLI to Claude: SQL over your diary, ratings, lists and the people behind each film, plus trends, taste and watchlist picks. Build the library first with `summer setup`; the extension only serves it.

tmdb_api_key.title: TMDB API Read Access Token
tmdb_api_key.description: Only needed for sync, when your feed has a film you have never logged before. The long Read Access Token, not the short v3 key.

database.title: Library file
database.description: Path to your letterboxd.duckdb. Leave empty for the per-user data directory, where `summer setup` puts it.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Offer no tool that changes anything: no sync, no list building, no marking lists ranked.
